name: lens-flare-vertical
title: Lens Flare (vertical)
description: Vertical: a camera lens flare: a bright star burst and a faint rainbow halo that slowly shimmer on the dark ground. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT); the flare keeps its optical colours (white star, rainbow halo) – only the ground is a variable. Placement full, top or bottom card; fades in and out on cues.
